# 调调 Tutorials: Import, Offline Playback and Queues

> Start with one owned track, then check importing, metadata, offline copies, queues, sleep timers and lyric sources.

## App and version

- [调调: Personal Music Player for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/diaodiao/index.md): Organise and play your own music with 调调, including file imports, Wi-Fi transfers, offline listening, lyrics, queues and compatible personal music servers.
Version listed: 1.0.1; checked 2026-11-17; iOS 17.6+ / iPadOS 17.6+.
This is the catalog baseline, not a promise that every release has identical UI. Individual guides specify their own version context.

## Lessons in learning order

- [1. Prepare audio for 调调: check format, size and permission separately](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-prepare-owned-audio-format-size-drm/index.md): Prepare one recognisable, traceable small audio file before importing. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [2. Import a first file into 调调 and reopen it](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-first-files-import-and-reopen/index.md): Trace a file from provider selection through importing and actual playback. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [3. Check metadata in 调调: filename, title and artwork have different sources](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-metadata-title-artist-artwork-identity/index.md): Build a field-by-field comparison for one owned track instead of relying on names or artwork. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [4. Transfer music to 调调 over Wi-Fi using the displayed address](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-wifi-browser-transfer-local-network-check/index.md): Trace one small track from a computer browser to the device, beyond merely opening the upload page. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [5. Prepare offline listening in 调调: visible, imported and playable are different states](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-offline-imported-copy-network-control/index.md): Compare one imported track online, offline and after restoring connectivity. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [6. Check the upcoming queue in 调调 with three tracks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-queue-next-track-order-small-set/index.md): Separate the current track from the upcoming queue and verify order by actual audio. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [7. Compare sequential, repeat and shuffle playback in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-sequential-repeat-shuffle-observation/index.md): Hold three tracks fixed and change only the playback mode, comparing expectation with observation. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [8. Check the sleep timer in 调调 separately from a track ending](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-sleep-timer-duration-end-check/index.md): Choose an observable short timer and check its starting conditions, ending and playback recovery. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [9. Check background and lock-screen controls in 调调 one step at a time](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-background-lockscreen-pause-output-check/index.md): Start with foreground playback and observe backgrounding, locking and recovery separately. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [10. Read lyrics in 调调: separate source text, timing and missing words](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-lyrics-source-timing-and-missing-text/index.md): Verify the track edition, then record available text, timing information and the actual lyric display. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [11. Reconcile three source files, selection counts and library results in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-multiselect-three-file-reconciliation/index.md): Prepare a manifest for three different tracks, import them together and retain item-level results rather than only a total. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [12. Compare a renamed duplicate and a new recording in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-duplicate-copy-cross-entry-result-check/index.md): Use an unchanged copy and a genuinely new sample to separate filename changes from duplicate-content handling. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [13. Connect a personal music server in 调调: check compatibility, address and library identity](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-personal-server-address-account-library-identity/index.md): Use an already confirmed compatible personal service and retain evidence of the connection and library identity. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [14. Search a personal server in 调调: known titles, result identity and no-hit cases](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-server-search-known-track-and-no-hit/index.md): Use two queries inside a verified library and identify each result’s source and recording edition. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [15. Verify local and server paths for similarly named music in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-local-server-same-track-two-paths/index.md): Retain separate provenance for an imported copy and server item instead of treating one playable path as proof of the other. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [16. Compare two music themes in 调调 1.0.1 and restore the original](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-music-themes-two-options-and-restoration/index.md): Use the published music-theme feature while checking selection, player appearance and track identity separately. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [17. Add, observe and remove a 调调 Home Screen widget](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-home-screen-widget-add-observe-remove/index.md): Use the system widget flow with actual installed choices, record display scope and preserve music data. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [18. Check light/dark readability in 调调 with the music theme fixed](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-light-dark-fixed-theme-readability/index.md): Compare light and dark states on one track and theme, retaining page-level differences rather than ranking modes. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [19. Compare 调调 player and lyric layouts as available iPad space changes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-ipad-player-lyrics-available-space/index.md): Hold track and appearance fixed while checking placement, content and return paths in two actual space states on one iPad. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [20. Recover a 调调 batch while retaining successes and retrying unresolved files](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-interrupted-batch-failed-item-recovery/index.md): Keep the original batch separate from retry rounds, correct one known condition and recheck unresolved items. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [21. Locate three audible anchors on a ninety-second track in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-ninety-second-anchors-playhead-position/index.md): Build a ten-, thirty- and seventy-second map for your own short recording, separating elapsed time, remaining time and the position actually heard. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [22. Check spoken stereo labels and a mono comparison in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-stereo-mono-spoken-channel-music-check/index.md): Use original left/right spoken labels to separate channel content, audible direction and the current playback output. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [23. Compare fixed-duration PCM WAV files in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-pcm-wav-fixed-duration-rate-depth-payload/index.md): Audit channels, sample rate, container bits and payload for two thirty-second PCM samples, then check importing, duration and audible playback separately. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [24. Map three source passages onto one combined track in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-combined-three-parts-source-local-time-map/index.md): Combine owned twenty-, thirty- and ten-second passages externally, map local passage times to track time, then locate them in the player. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [25. Separate queue duration, remaining time and paused elapsed time in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-queue-duration-elapsed-pause-time-ledger/index.md): Use owned forty-, eighty- and fifty-second clips to compare one natural queue run and a paused run, separating track duration from wall-clock elapsed time. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [26. Log three audio-to-lyric timing differences in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-timed-lyrics-three-anchor-offset-drift-log/index.md): For one verified track with available timed lyrics, use one clock for three audible onsets and lyric changes, distinguishing direction, trends and observation error. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [27. Identify repeated lyric occurrences by context and position in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-repeated-lyric-occurrence-context-position/index.md): Build occurrence cards for two repeated lines in one track edition, keeping neighboring context and audible positions instead of identifying a passage from matching words alone. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [28. Reconcile a changed two-item server collection in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-server-test-collection-before-after-membership/index.md): Change an already compatible owned test collection from A/B to B/C, then compare server data, the visible catalog and playback rather than infer agreement from equal totals. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [29. Check an imported item after moving only its external working copy in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-imported-item-after-external-working-copy-move/index.md): Preserve a master and move only a working copy between folders, then reopen its 调调 item and record source-path and local-playback states separately. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [30. Prepare source files and a one-track device handoff check for 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-new-device-source-package-one-track-check/index.md): Preserve originals and a three-track manifest, then check source availability and one imported track on your own target device without assuming automatic library migration. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
